description: Election Commission - Declare that K. Parameswary as a member of the Manthai East P/S
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Manthai East Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for selecting a new member, including the role of the political party and the declaration by the Returning Officer. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and related administrative matters, making it an Elections Gazette.
